subject: math
cluster: Understand and apply theorems about circles

items.prompt:
A circle tangent to all three sides of a triangle is the:
A) Circumcircle
B) Incircle
C) Great circle
D) Unit circle

The circumcenter is where the triangle's ____ meet.
A) Angle bisectors
B) Perpendicular bisectors
C) Medians
D) Altitudes

Opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral sum to:
A) $90°$
B) $180°$
C) $270°$
D) $360°$

The incenter is where the triangle's ____ meet.
A) Perpendicular bisectors
B) Angle bisectors
C) Medians
D) Altitudes

A cyclic quadrilateral has an angle of $70°$. Its opposite angle is:
A) $20°$
B) $70°$
C) $110°$
D) $290°$

The circumcenter is equidistant from the triangle's:
A) Sides
B) Vertices
C) Medians
D) Midpoints

steps: It is the center of the circle through the vertices.

items.prompt:
A cyclic quadrilateral has opposite angles $2x$ and $x$. Then $x=$
A) $30°$
B) $45°$
C) $60°$
D) $90°$

Why is the incenter equidistant from all three sides?
A) It lies on the medians
B) It lies on all three angle bisectors, and bisector points are equidistant from the two sides of the angle
C) It is a vertex
D) It is the circumcenter
items.answer: B) It lies on all three angle bisectors, and bisector points are equidistant from the two sides of the angle

steps: Angle-bisector points are equidistant from the sides.
